name: Approval Route Step
description: One step of a configured approval path. The assignee is resolved from the record, so a route survives a change of owner.

fields.label: Assignee Source
fields.options:
Document Owner
Document Approver
Document Sponsor
Document Liaison
Parent Document Owner
Named User
Role Queue
User Group
fields.description: Who decides the step. Role Queue and User Group send it to everyone holding the required role, or in the group: any of them may decide it.

fields.label: User Group
fields.description: The group whose members may decide this step, when the assignee source is User Group.
fields.provenance: P-8: routing of approvals to user groups

fields.label: Condition
fields.description: Optional structured condition over the document's fields, in the same shape the classification engine uses.
